desc:
⚽ Steal A Soccer Star  ⚽
Giant legends guard every pitch. The balls are theirs. Take them anyway.

🥅 SMASH the ball — the harder you hit it, the further the zone you unlock
🏃 Sneak in, grab a ball and RUN before the guardian wakes up
🎬 If he catches you, you'll watch it in cinematic slow motion. Each guardian gets you a different way
🎁 Open your balls for 70+ 3D footballers, each with his own celebration
💸 Line them up in your base and watch them dance and print cash every second
👟 12 BOOTS · 10 BALLS · unlock real skills: rainbow, around the world, sombrero, bicycle kick
🔁 REBIRTH to grow your base and pull the icons
🤝 Trade with friends, fill the Index, hunt the exclusives

9 zones. 9 guardians. Nobody walks out of the last one.

👍 Like + ⭐ Favourite for free rewards
🔔 Join the group for codes
